Downward Lookup Compilation (970 MB Active RAM · 91.7% Verified · 0% Broken)
How to run giant coding models inside tiny laptop memory and turn verified answers into millisecond reflexes.
1) Most requests repeat solved patterns, so running a giant neural network every time wastes memory and energy.
2) This cascade checks tiny truth tables first and streams specialist model slices from storage only when needed.
3) Once an automated test certifies a new answer, it compiles downward into a reusable millisecond skill.
